purpose: Second-pass bounded live method validation; full corpus extraction and database import remain out of scope

levels.standalone_e2e_pass: Delivered standalone program acquired fresh current public source, retained bytes/receipts, parsed and verified bounded outputs in this run without manually supplying source bodies
levels.cua_script_e2e_pass: Delivered script executed through supported Codex CUA APIs to acquire fresh source and persisted it programmatically; delivered parser and verifier then ran. Requires CUA runtime, not proof of standalone browser transport
levels.operator_assisted_live_pass: Fresh source acquisition included explicit human/agent manual capture or download stages; downstream delivered parser verified; manual stage and exact replay commands documented
levels.offline_only: Parser/replay verified on retained source, live acquisition pipeline not established
levels.blocked: Actual bounded live method attempt failed; exact stage, error, evidence and legitimate next action retained

required_evidence: actual script entry point and invocation, runtime/dependency versions
fresh retrieval timestamp and requested/final source URL
raw source artifact path and SHA256
observed readiness and identity check, transport responses where exposed
source-node/output counts with denominator and scope
initial/final source version or inventory markers, or explicit unavailable status
no silent fallback to old retained source, mock transport or manual body substitution
code frozen before final tests; final script hashes bind the actual executed revision
